summary: NCL Corporation Ltd., subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd., closed a private offering of $950.0 million 8.750% senior notes due 2031. Net proceeds of about $941.7 million, plus cash, funded the redemption of all 6.125% senior notes due 2028 issued by NCL Finance, repayment of about $376.3 million under a senior secured revolving loan facility, and prepayment of roughly $42.2 million of export-credit backed debt. The notes pay semi-annually beginning April 15, 2027, mature October 15, 2031, and include a make-whole call before October 15, 2028, and a 40% equity-clawback at 108.750%. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation. Watch execution and leverage reduction.
